claim: The monitoring workflow names SHA-256 for full-text page hashes and MD5/SHA-256 for file checksum comparison
sub_question: Which hash primitive does the monitoring workflow name for full-text page hashes and file checksum comparison?
evidence: Change Detection Methods table lists Full text hash as SHA-256 of entire page and File checksum comparison as MD5/SHA-256 of downloaded files.
quote_or_anchor: SHA-256 hash of entire page; fast equality check, no detail on what changed | MD5/SHA-256 of downloaded files; detect binary or structural changes
notes: In-repo monitoring-change-detection branch reference; SHA-256 is the primitive named for both methods.
